description: Searches the web through the Ezkielyna API (POST /v1/search) and returns 1-10 results with title, URL and a snippet. Use it for recent facts, docs or news, then read a page with a fetch tool if needed. Counts toward the session cap.

time_range.description: Optional: only results from the last day/week/month/year.

name: web_search
title: Cari di web / Web search
